A vast volcanic cavern, lava channels glowing molten-orange through the cracked basalt floor, heat-haze shimmering above mountains of gold, the rough walls rising thirty meters into sulfurous shadow, stalactites weeping mineral tears overhead.
An immense ruined dwarven vault, colossal carved pillars and shattered arches receding into darkness, a single pale shaft of light lancing through a cracked ceiling onto the heaped treasure below.

A crystal grotto where great translucent formations jut from every surface, refracting soft inner luminescence into shifting rainbow bands across the hoard, the cavern vaulting upward into glittering, jewel-like darkness.
A flooded sea-cave, the hoard resting on a broad shelf above black water, shafts of filtered green-blue light plunging through submerged vents below, the ceiling lost in salty, echoing shadow.

An immense natural cathedral-cavern, stalactites descending like stone fangs from a vault lost in blackness, bioluminescent fungus carpeting the upper ledges and casting a cold blue glow across the treasure below.

The throne-hall of a dead king, crumbling tapestries and toppled statues surrounding the hoard, guttering witch-fire burning in iron sconces along the walls, the far end swallowed in absolute darkness.
A mountain's hollow heart, a perfectly spherical void of titanic scale, veins of glowing orange magma threading the walls like circuitry, the hoard a tiny island of gold on a central rock shelf.

A tomb-complex of carved pillars, row upon row of bas-relief columns retreating endlessly in all directions, pale ghost-light seeping from the carved eyes of stone funerary masks, the floor thick with silent gold.

A glacier ice-cave, the hoard locked partially in ancient blue ice, frigid walls translucent and deep, exterior moonlight filtering through thirty meters of glacial mass and casting everything in cold silver-white radiance.

A temple sanctum choked with massive root systems, ancient stone cracked and heaved by centuries of growth, phosphorescent lichen blooming along every root and painting the buried hoard in soft, sickly green light.

A bottomless pit-cavern, the hoard arrayed on a broad stone ledge above a shaft descending into absolute blackness, chains of burning braziers bolted into the rock face casting wavering amber light downward.
A deep coastal sea-stack cavern, open to a churning grey sky through a blowhole far above, columns of salt-mist catching pale daylight while the hoard gleams on black wet rock below.

A sunken forest hollow where an ancient petrified forest now stands underground, fossilized trunks rising into a low stone ceiling, foxfire glowing in the mineralized wood-grain and illuminating the scattered gold.

A collapsed coliseum buried deep underground, tiered stone seating surrounding a central arena floor heaped with treasure, cracks in the dome above admitting thin blades of distant daylight that cross like spotlights.

A vast obsidian chamber beneath a dormant volcano, perfectly smooth black walls reflecting every glimmer of the single eternal flame burning atop the hoard's summit, the reflection multiplying it into a thousand cold mirrors.

An underwater grotto accessible only by submerged passage, the hoard resting on a risen shelf above waterline, the pool below glowing with fierce bioluminescence, the cavern ceiling dripping with reflected aquamarine light.

A massive sandstone canyon-cave in deep desert, carved smooth by ancient rivers, the hoard golden against red stone, a single vertical shaft of blinding desert sunlight striking through a ceiling vent at noon.

A ruined elven waystation deep underground, delicate arched stonework and carved vines now crumbling, globes of preserved elven daylight-stone still glowing faintly cold-white along the walls, the hoard heaped across the mosaic floor.

An enormous geode cavern, walls entirely encrusted with amethyst crystal the size of wagons, the stones holding a trapped inner violet glow that pulses softly and steadily, bathing the treasure in purple radiance.

A sea-floor canyon somehow sealed and drained millennia ago, barnacled stone walls still encrusted with ancient shells, the hoard resting on a flat sediment floor, pale bioluminescent jellyfish-things drifting the upper air above.

A subterranean river delta, the hoard spread across a wide gravel bar between dark flowing channels, colonies of luminous cave-fish schooling in the water and throwing rippling silver light up onto the cave ceiling.

A titan's burial mound, the interior an earthen dome of immense scale, grave-goods of a vanished giant race mingling with the dragon's added treasure, smoldering incense burners left by ancient mourners still trailing dim red embers.

A wind-carved mesa interior, the hollow heart of a flat-topped mountain, natural windows abraded by centuries of storm admitting howling wind and thin bands of high-altitude sunlight that sweep slowly across the hoard.

A deep black-rock mine long abandoned, timber supports rotting and collapsed, the hoard filling the central shaft-junction, a single ancient dwarven lantern of cold blue everburning flame hanging untouched above it all on its chain.

A bone-cathedral cavern, the compressed skeletons of megafauna forming the walls and vault in layered geological strata, calcium-white surfaces glowing faintly under the dragon's own smoldering breath, which hangs as low red smoke above the gold.
